authorizationRuntimeEvidence.facts: Current immutable DRAFT v41 contains 252 capabilities, 24 policies, 17 expressions, 64 predicates, and 1017 routes; no hcm.audit.evidence.view.
Latest immutable index entry is v41 and the index has 41 contiguous versions.
Canonical authorization generator source lacks the SYS-001 HCM audit capability/routes.

Current route validation requires command/object-version stepUpCommandBindings for every direct HIGH/CRITICAL STEPUP capability except two unrelated legacy exceptions. It has no safe model for an ELEVATED-only read-only PAGE/DATA GET, so SYS-001 requires a two-route allowlisted validation branch rather than clearing activationPolicy or using a capability expression.
Existing loader imports indexed versions as DRAFT only and never approves, activates, or rolls back.
Current Java lineage seals only v1-v40 and requires latestVersion=40, which conflicts with the checked-in v41 index.
Capability evaluation supports entitlement, permission, responsibility, step-up, and SoD hooks but has no HCM auditor package policy.
Static SoD recognizes only three Approvals capability cases and has no SOD_HRIS_AUDIT_INDEPENDENCE implementation.
The Gateway strips/rebuilds trusted decision headers and supports fixed query constraints, but its server purpose map has no HCM audit route.
Latest Platform-owned HCM PEP projection predates v41 and contains no audit-control binding.
Registry loads the v40 Platform HCM projection and has no SYS-001 audit bindings.
Current shared audit family enforcement does not implement the exact HCM package/duty/purpose/field/SoD profile or generic bypass fence.
Header catalog lacks the purpose, field-policy revision, authorization revision, active-mode, and subject constants needed by the HCM owner PEP.
